I'm seeing movement inside of the building. Recruit set up—… wait. Is that Demo?
Oh-ho! No way, AND Hops? I had a feeling it'd be one of you but not both!
Well look what the dog dragged in. Haha! It's good to see you, buddy. It's also nice to see familiar faces after being ditched.
We heard the distress call and had to do something. The leader of these guys ended up with a nasty bite and turned before injuring a few others. They locked him in the freezer for now.
You disobeyed direct orders. Not sure I'd call it 'Ditched'. Though, I'm glad you're both alright. We need to figure a way out of here, otherwise we'll be drowning in zombies.
The train to Cyber City isn't that far from here and we can walk the tracks. We just didn't have the manpower to bring anyone wounded that far. With your help though, we'll have a chance.
Hm. If we take the railway the APC won't be able to follow us. Not to mention not being able to carry everyone. Maybe it can take the most injured while we bring everyone else through the tracks.
Good plan. It'll keep us from getting swarmed too. The zombies have already caught up to us, so help me get the survivors ready to move. Anyone who can't goes into the APC.
Watching these things run reminds me of how Hops got his name. Come on, Hops. Tell em' — Tell em' about the time in basic you pranked the NCO and —
You mean the time YOU pranked the NCO and I took the fall for it.
Haha! — Oh man… He couldn't even run. They tied his legs together and made him jump like a rabbit while the rest of us hunted him down.
That was training for — what — a week straight? Man that was good. You even got a nickname out of it.
The APC is loaded. We're waiting for the rest to gather their things. Glad you two found your bromance when we're about to be eaten.
There's a break in the horde after this group. Should we take it?
Everyone, on me! We're going to the tracks!
One icon and dialogue is randomly chosen upon defeat:
•Mission Failed, we'll get em' next time.
•Mistakes are just part of the journey..
